snippet.title: Ayna: Shattered Truth - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Explore a shattered fantasy world and uncover its forgotten secrets in Ayna: Shattered Truth, a story-driven 2.8D Metroidvania action-adventure.

Choose your path through interconnected environments, discover hidden passages and master fluid movement abilities including dashes, ground slides and wall runs to reach new areas. Unlock new abilities and return to previously explored locations to uncover paths that were once out of reach.

Face a variety of enemies and bosses with fast-paced melee and ranged combat, combining combos, special attacks and gameplay-altering upgrades to create a playstyle of your own.

But not every encounter ends in combat. Meet a cast of charming characters throughout your journey and shape your relationships through your choices — whether you befriend them, upset them or turn them against you.

Wishlist Ayna: Shattered Truth now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1742390/Ayna_Shattered_Truth/
